The '''''Legacy''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was owned by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
The ''Legacy'' was unlike any other [[Starship/Legends|starship]] referred to in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] records and while some of its parts appeared to be custom-made, others incorporated [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]]-style design elements. The ship was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of extremely efficient construction, making the ''Legacy'' very fast for its age.<ref name="Priorities" />

==History==
Parts of the ''Legacy'' were constructed over two millennia before the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the vessel had been disassembled. During the Clone Wars, crates containing the starship's parts were shipped to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] from a departure point in the [[Taris system/Legends|Taris system]]. Jeht and his associate [[Trilinae Untaire]] investigated the parts shipments in an attempt to find out who was sending the ship to Jeht and why, but they were unsuccessful at discovering the vessel's origins. Jeht began to re-assemble the ship and he found that some parts were missing, so he called in some favors and obtained the parts that he needed, allowing him to restore the ship to working order.<ref name="Priorities" />

Jeht later kept the ''Legacy'' aboard his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Maelstrom (Maelstrom-class)/Legends|''Maelstrom'']].<ref name="One Minute to Midnight">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20060302OneMinute|text=Living Force: One Minute to Midnight|int=Living Force: One Minute to Midnight}}</ref> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], shortly after the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], the ''Maelstrom'' engaged the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Shadowblade]]'' in a [[Battle of Cularin/Legends|battle]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and Jeht ordered [[Milinae Untaire]]&mdash;the sister of Trillinae&mdash;and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R-0]] to take the ''Legacy'' and flee the battle to safety.<ref name="Last Stand">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20070201LastStand|text=Living Force: Last Stand|int=Living Force: Last Stand}}</ref>
